title: Early Fund-Life NAV Financing: Closing the Capital Deployment Gap Before it Opens
summary: Private equity funds often deploy only a portion of committed capital into return-generating investments, leaving a meaningful amount of capital on the sid
body_markdown:
Private equity funds often deploy only a portion of committed capital into return-generating investments, leaving a meaningful amount of capital on the sidelines due to fees, reserves, and uncalled commitments.


In the latest piece from our[GP Solutions](https://www.orix.com/private-credit/gp-solutions/) team, we examine how early fund-life NAV financing can help sponsors address this structural inefficiency, increase capital deployment, and enhance fund-level returns without altering investment strategy or portfolio construction.
